title: Nenu Ready Gains Momentum as VV Vinayak Endorses Trinadha Rao Nakkina's Entertainer
excerpt: Telugu director VV Vinayak praised Nenu Ready at its second single launch, comparing director Trinadha Rao Nakkina's work to his earlier hits Nenu Local and Cinema Choopistha Maamaa, while Bollywood's Nargis Fakhri marks her Tollywood debut.
body:
• VV Vinayak attended the Nenu Ready second single launch on July 31, calling lead actor Havish a potential "successful commercial hero" and likening producer Koneru Satyanarayana to the legendary Ramoji Rao.
  • Bollywood actress Nargis Fakhri makes her Telugu debut with a special dance number in the film; the first single Konchem Konchem featuring her appearance has already become a chartbuster.
  • Directed by Trinadha Rao Nakkina of Nenu Local and Cinema Choopistha Maamaa fame, the film stars Havish and Kavya Thapar with music by Mickey J Meyer and a supporting cast headlined by Brahmanandam and Vennela Kishore.

Telugu filmmaker VV Vinayak threw his weight behind upcoming entertainer Nenu Ready at the launch of its second single, Merupule Merupule, on July 31, drawing direct comparisons between the film and director Trinadha Rao Nakkina's previous commercial successes.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=DcSD0tmHnKg

"I've always admired Trinadha Rao Nakkina's Cinema Choopistha Mama and Nenu Local, and I wish this film enjoys the same level of success and audience acceptance," Vinayak said at the event, according to Gulte.

A Director's Track Record and a Producer's Vision

Nakkina built his reputation with Cinema Choopistha Maamaa and the Nani-starrer Nenu Local, both of which performed well at the box office and cemented his standing as a reliable commercial entertainer director. Nenu Ready pairs him with young actor Havish, known for films like Nuvvila, Genius, and Seven.

"Satyanarayana reminded me of the legendary Ramoji Rao. I truly hope this film earns a reputation as remarkable as KL University. I strongly believe Havish has all the qualities needed to emerge as a successful commercial hero."

— VV Vinayak, Director

The film is produced by Koneru Satyanarayana and Nikhila Koneru under the Harniks India LLP banner. Kavya Thapar plays the female lead opposite Havish, with Vikranth Srinivas handling the story and dialogues.

Musical Rollout and Nargis Fakhri's Telugu Debut

The promotional campaign has leaned heavily on music. The first single, Konchem Konchem, released on July 25, marks the Telugu debut of Bollywood actress Nargis Fakhri, who appears in a special dance number. Composed by Mickey J Meyer with lyrics by veteran lyricist Ramajogayya Sastry and vocals by Sameera Bharadwaj, the breezy romantic track quickly gained traction online.

The second single, Merupule Merupule, takes a different tonal direction. Described as an upbeat youth anthem celebrating confidence and determination, the track features lyrics by Krishna Kanth and spirited vocals by Ritesh G Rao and Lakshmi Meghana. Meyer infuses the composition with pulsating energy, pivoting from the first single's romantic register.

Havish acknowledged the collaborative nature of the production at the launch. "Everyone associated with the film has watched it and is delighted with the outcome. Both our producers are extremely confident," he said. He promised abundant entertainment, pointing to the comedy ensemble of Brahmanandam, Vennela Kishore, Murali Sharma, Srilakshmi, and VTV Ganesh.

Tollywood's Cross-Industry Appeal

Nargis Fakhri's entry into Telugu cinema reflects an ongoing trend of Bollywood talent crossing into South Indian film industries. The makers unveiled her first-look poster in May, describing her appearance as the "ultimate glam blast" — a calculated move to broaden the film's appeal beyond its core Telugu audience. The song's recording sessions at Inspire Studios in both Hyderabad and California, with mastering by Darren Vermaas in New York, underscore the increasingly global production footprint of Telugu film music.

What's Next

With two singles released and the teaser already generating buzz, Nenu Ready appears to be building toward a release in the coming months. The makers have yet to announce an official release date. The film's ensemble cast — spanning veteran comedians and a Bollywood crossover name — positions it as a broad-audience commercial play in what is shaping up to be a competitive second half of 2026 for Tollywood.
nri_angle: Nenu Ready's global music production — recorded in Hyderabad and California studios, mastered in New York — reflects the increasingly international footprint of Telugu cinema that resonates with diaspora audiences.
author: Diaspora Desk
